pull.title: KAFKA-21353: The incorrect parameter in internal-api-checker.md breaks the site build
pull.body:
The Hugo site build fails because docs/apis/internal-api-checker.md uses
`{{< param fullDotVersion >}}`, and `fullDotVersion` is not a defined site param.

This PR replaces it with the hardcoded version `4.4.0`, matching how other docs
pages (e.g. apis/_index.md, quickstart.md, docker.md) refer to the release version.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

reviews.body:
LGTM

The hardcoding is fine for now, since we don’t have such parameters yet. We could revisit it if replacing the versions in each release becomes too tedious.

 </dependency>
 ```

issue.title: MINOR: Update Kafka website to 4.4.0
issue.body:
Updates the website for the Apache Kafka 4.4.0 release.

- Sync `content/en/44` with the `docs/` directory of the `4.4` branch, including the doc fixes merged after the 4.4.0 tag (KIP-1241 delay upload section, quickstart cleanup, Docker SASL/SSL section, `{version}` links).
- Add the 4.4.0 release announcement blog post covering all 25 KIPs shipped in this release.
- Add 4.4.0 to the downloads page and move 4.1.2 to archived releases.
- Refresh the `KafkaStreams` javadoc for `removeStreamThread`.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>, Jian Fu <fujian1115@gmail.com>, Jiayao Sun <jiayao.s@outlook.com>, Gabriella Fu <gabriellafu46@gmail.com>
